mapper.select:
SELECT id,name,contact,phone,address,auditStatus,businessStatus,orderCount,joinedAt,auditReason,hasPhoto,listed,bindingId FROM ( SELECT id,name,contact,phone,address,audit_status AS auditStatus,business_status AS businessStatus, order_count AS orderCount,joined_at AS joinedAt,audit_reason AS auditReason, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM merchant_store_photo p WHERE p.merchant_id=merchant.id) AS hasPhoto,listed,display_order AS sortOrder, 0 AS reviewRow,
(SELECT CAST(i.id AS CHAR) FROM merchant_identity i WHERE i.merchant_id=merchant.id) NULL AS bindingId FROM merchant WHERE deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('revision:',m.id),r.name,r.contact,r.phone,r.address,r.status,'PROFILE_REVISION', m.order_count,m.joined_at,r.reason,r.image_data IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM merchant_store_photo p WHERE p.merchant_id=m.id),m.listed,m.display_order,1,NULL FROM merchant_profile_revision r JOIN merchant m ON m.id=r.merchant_id WHERE r.status='PENDING_REVIEW' AND m.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('application:',identity_id),name,contact,phone,address,status,'ENROLLMENT_APPLICATION', 0,DATE_FORMAT(submitted_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),reason,TRUE,FALSE,0,2,NULL FROM merchant_enrollment_request WHERE status='PENDING_REVIEW' ) records ORDER BY reviewRow,sortOrder,id

SELECT id,name,phone,gender,availability,available_time AS availableTime,audit_status AS auditStatus, deliveries,COALESCE((SELECT a.balance_cents FROM finance_account a WHERE a.id=r.id AND a.type='RIDER'),r.balance_cents) AS balanceCents, joined_at AS joinedAt,audit_reason AS auditReason,enabled, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM rider_student_card c WHERE c.rider_id=r.id) AS hasPhoto,
(SELECT i.id FROM rider_identity i WHERE i.rider_id=r.id) NULL AS bindingId FROM rider r ORDER BY id
SELECT id,username,enabled,created_at AS createdAt FROM admin_user ORDER BY id
SELECT user_id AS userId,role_code AS roleCode FROM admin_user_role ORDER BY user_id,role_code
SELECT id,actor,action_name AS action,target_id AS target,created_at AS createdAt FROM admin_audit_log WHERE action_name LIKE 'admin.%' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_user_role(user_id,role_code) SELECT id,#{role} FROM admin_user WHERE username=#{username}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_user u JOIN admin_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.id WHERE u.enabled=TRUE AND ur.role_code='super'
